name: Jake Hobbs
imdb_disambiguator: IMDb renders him as 'Jake Hobbs (I)', meaning there is more than one Jake Hobbs on IMDb. Our person_id is bound to nm14257647; do not match this name by string alone.
NOTABLE: 35 actor credits against 11 already on file, and he is on the Craft GoodShort target list. people.csv already holds aka_names 'Jacob Douglas Hobbs' for him.
DUPLICATE_ON_IMDB: 'The Princess with the Cursed Mark' is listed TWICE, both 73 episodes and both 2025, but with different characters ('Don Leonardo Anderson' vs 'Don Leonard') and different ratings (7.9 vs 7.8). That is almost certainly ONE production entered twice on IMDb, not two shows. Both rows are staged so the evidence survives, but applying both would double-credit him - rule before applying.
MULTI_CHARACTER_ROWS: Four credits show what reads as two character names run together, which on IMDb usually means one actor playing two roles: 'Sebastian Whitmore / Alexander Whitmore', 'Cody Colby / Bella', 'Chris / Julian', 'General Lafayette / Nick Fontaine'. Recorded with a slash. NOT split into separate credits and NOT guessed which is primary.

CROSS_REFERENCE: He plays Justin in 'Saving Nora, Nora the Virgin'; Kyle Fragnoli, transcribed from another PDF in this same batch, plays Anthony Gray in it. Two tracked actors, one title.
PINEDRAMA_TWIN_WARNING: Two of his credits, 'Campaigning for Love' and 'Caution, Cute Baby Alert!', are titles we hold TWICE - once normally and once as a -pinedrama shadow row. Applying by title string would pick one arbitrarily. These are in the 73 pending Cyan's PineDrama ruling.
